sentences.text:
Shri Neeraj Kumar Tiwari - advocate for the applicant
 Shri Rajeev Pandey -P.L. for the State.

Order 
This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita Act, 2023.

2.The applicant is in custody since 4.5.2024 in connection with Crime No.27/2024 registered at P.S.- Kusmi District Sidhi (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 342, 376(3), 376(2)(N),
294, 323, 506, 366 of IPC and Sections 5-L, 6, 3/4 of POCSO Act.

3.Prosecution story, in brief, is that applicant repeatedly committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault on minor prosecutrix.
4.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that at the time of incident, prosecutrix was aged 17 years 11 months.
No injury has been found on the person of minor prosecutrix.

After investigation,
charge sheet has been filed and the applicant is in custody since 4.5.2024.
No custodial interrogation is required in the case.

On above grounds, it is urged that NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:16971 2 MCRC-14141-2025 applicant be released on bail.
5.On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the application.

Mahendra @ Panchu Jaiswal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132488533/
1 6.Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7 . It is directed that the present applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8.This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9.Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately to applicant through concerned Jail Superintendent.
10.Certified copy as per rules.
